blocks.title: Identify protected work
blocks.text: Original software code, images, text and music can attract copyright automatically.

blocks.title: Check permission
blocks.text: Licence terms, ownership and limited exceptions determine permitted copying and reuse.

blocks.title: Use responsibly
blocks.text: Respect allowed distribution, modification, attribution and restrictions.

blocks.text: A permissive licence may allow use/modification/distribution subject to its terms, generally keeping the copyright/licence notice. Check the exact code's licence and third-party dependencies rather than assuming all free online code is unrestricted.
